title: Genetic of Aortic Valve Stenosis - Clinical and Therapeutic Implications
brief_summary: Pathophysiology of Aortic Valve Stenosis remains poorly known. The aim of the present study is to identify genetic factors involved in this disease using a case control trial design.
raw_criteria:
Patients:

Inclusion criteria :

* Age \>=18 years
* Pure isolated degenerative aortic valve stenosis

Exclusion criteria :

* Rheumatic, congenital or post-radiation aortic stenosis
* Severe renal insufficiency (clearance \< 30 ml/min)
* Aortic insufficiency \> or = grade 2/4
* Other valve disease \> or = grade 2/4

Controls

Inclusion criteria :

\- Age \>=18 years

Exclusion criteria :

* Known first degree relative with aortic valve stenosis
* Severe renal insufficiency (clearance \< 30 ml/min)
* Any valve disease \> or = grade 2/4
study_population: case control study Case = patients with aortic valve stenosis Controls = participants free of aortic valve stenosis
